title: E0058: Cookie missing Secure or HttpOnly
plain_english: Cookies used for sessions or authentication should usually set `Secure` and `HttpOnly`. `Secure` limits cookies to HTTPS connections, and `HttpOnly` prevents JavaScript from reading the cookie.
why_matters: Without `Secure`, a cookie may be sent over an insecure connection. Without `HttpOnly`, a cross-site scripting bug can expose the cookie to client-side scripts.
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` and `setrawcookie()` with missing or disabled `secure` and `httponly` options
`session_set_cookie_params()` with missing or disabled `secure` and `httponly` options
Array options, positional arguments, and named arguments
Array keys are matched case-insensitively, so both `httponly` and `httpOnly` are recognized
